name: Formcn
summary: Visual builder that generates production-ready shadcn/ui forms and multi-step flows as React code.
description: Build shadcn-styled forms in the browser: pick one of 13 templates (signup, credit card, login, employee onboarding, feedback, waitlist, contact, multi-step, job application, event registration, product order, customer support) or start blank, arrange fields in one or several steps, and get consistent React code with Zod validation. Generated code and dependencies install with the shadcn registry CLI; Formcn AI scaffolds the fields from a description.
contains: 13 form templates (signup, login, credit card, job application …)
one-step and multi-step forms with a stepper
code and dependencies added via the shadcn registry CLI
field types: input, combobox, date picker, file upload, slider, tag input
